title: IMPLEMENT Sales History, Dynamic API Discovery & FK Handling
content:
**What**: Added sales history island with local timezone date range filtering, dynamic API base discovery (auto-probe with port scanning), inline edit/delete client and product management, offline POS order drafts, and robust PostgreSQL FK constraint error handling.
**Why**: Ensures smooth client-side operation when Express API ports vary, provides accurate date filtering for sales reports without UTC offset bugs, and surfaces human-readable error messages when deleting entity records with active dependencies.
**Where**: `src/lib/apiClient.ts`, `src/components/facturacion/SalesHistoryIsland.tsx`, `src/modules/facturas/facturas.repository.ts`, `src/modules/clientes/clientes.controller.ts`.
**Learned**: Drizzle ORM wraps PostgreSQL errors inside nested cause objects (`error.cause.code`), requiring deep property inspection to correctly catch code 23503 and return friendly HTTP 400 responses.
